The other day, Kagege took advantage
of being hard to notice and snuck
aboard the Uzushio, mo.

rows.label: tlk42100111_02_msg0002
rows.name:
Then I found what looked like a good
Salvage Point, mo.

rows.label: tlk42100111_02_msg0003
rows.name:
It's a hidden spot even Goldmund
salvagers haven't noticed, so I'm sure
I'll find something good, mo.
